title: Chapter 314
text:
As soon as Han Xiao left, Raylan could not do anything. Even they could not enter the galaxy, but Han Xiao did it so easily. The galaxy had always been hidden by a veil for the Six Nations. The communicator they got from Godora was a watered-down version. It was restricted to only communicating with Godora and could not use other functions.

This was the suppression of the civilization level. The Six Nations could only compromise.

Therefore, they did not know about the function of the Galactic Travel Agency and did not understand how Han Xiao did it. They even thought that there might be an unknown galactic organization behind Han Xiao. This guy had always been mysterious and kept them in the dark.

As the ruling authority of Blue Star, they found out that one person had a backer that was stronger than the entire planet. This uneasiness and anger were indescribable.

Raylan was the initiator of the pressure from the Six Nations. The pressure became meaningless, and they even revealed that they had a spaceship. They suffered a double loss and could not say anything.

This difference in expectations was like students from the same village. The Six Nations wanted to beat Han Xiao in an exam, but they found out that he had already been recommended to a famous school in a big city. They could not catch up and were extremely disappointed.

…

Through the porthole of the airdrop cabin, the ground gradually shrank. Short Horn Star rose into the sky, and the sky turned dark. Short Horn Star's anti-gravity engine operated silently and entered the dark outer space. At this time, the airdrop cabin shook. The huge spaceship was breaking through the atmosphere and entering the universe.

The Blue Star's full appearance slowly appeared. The deep blue ocean and the land that was dotted with greenery could be seen from a bird's eye view. Han Xiao saw that the entire Andrea continent was charred black. The war and nuclear explosion had caused the most damage to this continent.

His experience on Planet Aquamarine flashed through his mind. He had started from scratch, completed the primitive accumulation of capital, and rose on this planet. Now, he had finally stepped onto a higher stage. Although he did not care about some of his friends on this planet, he did not leave without nostalgia. Although it was cool to not drag things out, the feeling of leaving a city without any worries was not as good as leaving behind some ties.

Bennett, Hella, and Aurora. Although they were not very close, they were all people with great potential. Purely from the perspective of benefits, Han Xiao also hoped that Hella and her sister would have grown up the next time they met and could provide him with help.

Looking at the planet that was gradually disappearing, he thought, Wait for me to come back.

Then, Han Xiao decisively looked away. He no longer looked at the planet and turned to look at the tunnel that led inside the spaceship.

Chi!

The metal door that connected the box airdrop cabin to the spaceship split into four diamond-shaped pieces from the middle and then retracted into the wall. The tunnel opened, and there was a square metal corridor in front of them. The indicator light next to the door turned from red to green, indicating that the passengers should board the ship through the tunnel.

Kerlodd urged, "Hurry up, I'm going to have a drink."

"What's the rush? I have all your money."

Han Xiao waved his hand. Dozens of players stopped and looked at him curiously. They then carried the supply boxes and walked forward.

Halfway through the tunnel, there was a mechanical arch with a screen next to it. This was a device used to detect the passengers' physical condition and body structure. It was convenient to identify the passengers' race and provide appropriate arrangements. Everyone walked past it one by one. The screen showed that everything was normal. Then, a transparent container rose from the floor. It was filled with simple translation devices that were free for the passengers to use.

Han Xiao asked everyone to put them on. Then, a synthetic female voice came out from the screen.

"Welcome to the Short Horn Star Travel Service. Your passenger number is sg1853. You have reserved fifty seats. There are more than enough people. Please pay the fee …"

With a few more people, Han Xiao followed the instructions. He still had more than 700 Enas in his account. Then, the voice said, "Amount confirmed. Class: Normal Class. Personal luggage storage function activated. Please store your luggage and continue forward." Then, a hole appeared in the wall. Inside was a running caterpillar that transported the luggage to the warehouse. After placing the supply boxes inside, everyone moved forward again.

Finally, they reached the end of the tunnel. It was a large elevator. After everyone entered, the elevator started to move. It moved up and down and moved parallel to each other. Of course, the interstellar travel ship did not force the passengers to sit in their seats to complete the journey. Instead, it was more like a cruise ship. There were many entertainment and resting spaces on the spaceship. Different cabins had different resting spaces, and they were divided according to the environment that the species adapted to. For example, species that were adapted to oxygen and low gravity would be in the same hall, just like Han Xiao. Species that lived in special environments also had their own places. For example, there were aquatic creatures, anaerobic creatures, and light-sensitive creatures. There were many situations.

Ka! The elevator suddenly stopped. The door opened, and a bustling scene greeted them.

In front of them was a huge space. This was the hall of the normal class. It was very spacious, and there were all kinds of entertainment facilities. It was like a combination of a bar, a banquet hall, and a party venue. There were bars, resting areas, and private rooms. On one side of the hall was a huge window, and one could directly see the bright universe outside. The stars were like a long river. All kinds of species came and went. A creature that looked like a birdman with feathers was chatting with a lion in clothes. Beside them, there was a bearded dwarf and a creature with a beast head with long fangs drinking. The smells and sounds of different creatures mixed together to create a strange feeling. The players had an inexplicable feeling of uneasiness. This was the first time they had come into contact with another race.

"What race is that? His head is like a wooden club." Second Prince was amazed.

"Yours is quite similar too." Sun Eggplant laughed.

"Don't always bully him. You are violating my rights," King Admiral said lazily.

The veins on Second Prince's forehead bulged as he gave the two of them the middle finger.

Rainy Kim stared at the window, admiring the starry sky like a silent beauty. Twinkle Fried Rice slowly moved to her side. He hesitated and wanted to talk to her, but his shoulder was pulled back by Hao Tian.

Hao Tian dragged Sleepy Winter and Twinkle Fried Rice and said seriously, "We will act according to the situation later. Let's see if we can trigger some missions … Fried Rice, why do you look so bitter?"

The players were shocked, and they whispered among themselves. Han Xiao, however, was not surprised.

The universe was bizarre and variegated. He had seen too many races and was very experienced. Soon, a humanoid female steward in uniform walked forward. Her skin was light red, and she had a polite smile on her face.

The female stewardess quickly scanned the crowd and walked in front of Kerlodd. She smiled warmly and said, "Respected Godoran, your room is ready."

In the Colton Star Cluster, Godora was a well-known race. They had a high status, and travel groups were like public transport spaceships. It was a cheaper way to travel, so it was rare to see a Godora.

The steward treated Kerlodd as the leader at first glance. As for Han Xiao and the others, she ignored them.

Kerlodd was a little surprised. He glanced at Han Xiao and nodded. "Okay, got it."

The flight attendant gave Kerlodd the room number and permission, then winked at him before leaving. She was obviously trying to seduce him. Godorans were very popular, so this female flight attendant of the [Anwei Race] did not mind doing something with Kerlodd. Some races could be mixed, and some had reproductive isolation. The races in the universe were very open.

Kerlodd was a pure-blooded, so he was not interested in females of other races. He turned around and gave the thing to Han Xiao.

Han Xiao put it away casually. He was happy that Godora was the leader and the shield.

Kerlodd said, "We are on the ship. The deal is done. When can I contact the headquarters?"

"Don't worry. The final stop is Juberly Hub. You can go home by yourself. I won't stop you."

"That's great." Kerlodd rubbed his hands and said awkwardly, "I want to go for a drink. This …"

"That's all. Don't drink too much." Han Xiao transferred 10 Enas to him and sighed to himself. Extorting the other party's savings and giving them pocket money, there were not many good people like him in this world.

After getting the money, Kerlodd ran to the bar happily. He was a hedonist, so he spent most of his money on drinks and energy drinks.

Han Xiao brought everyone to the room. The players looked around curiously, and Bun-Hit-Dog recorded excitedly. From time to time, other races would look over, but they would look away. The Universe Human Race was very common in the galaxy, and there were quite a number of such races in this economy class hall.

When they reached the door, Han Xiao thought for a while, turned around, and said, "You guys can do whatever you want. Ask around for information about the passengers."

The players could not hold back their curiosity, so they quickly scattered. The players were his eyes and ears, so he did not need to ask around himself. Furthermore, the players might be able to accept missions from the passengers and earn Enas. He could use some methods to exchange for items, so it was like the players were earning money for him.
